how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Madras Project Associate-II Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 21-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Madras to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Madras Project Associate-II Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 21-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Madras to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Madras Project Associate-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Project Associate-II position at IIT Madras is 21 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate-II post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a four-year bachelor's degree in Natural or Materials Sciences or a Master's Degree in Natural or materials Sciences or a bachelor's degree in engineering or technology, along with two years of R&D experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-II position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 28,000 per month plus 30% HRA.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate-II post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Project Associate-II position at IIT Madras.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the IIT Madras Project Associate-II recruitment must be submitted online.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Associate-II role?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves shortlisting of applications, followed by an interview and document verification.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.

faq.question: Q9. What is the duration of the contract for the Project Associate-II position?
faq.answer: The job type is mentioned as 'Contract'. Specific duration details should be checked in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. Does IIT Madras provide age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Information regarding age relaxation is not explicitly detailed in the provided data. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for specific details.
